method.coverage: All answer, candidate reasons, factor interpretations, uncertainties and directions reviewed independently against frozen user question/canonical/evidence. No other reviewer consulted.
method.quote_offsets: Exact UTF-16 code-unit raw response.txt start/end, end exclusive. path names actual parsed JSON field; offsets verified within that field serialized value.

method.criteria_pass_meaning: Dimension-specific manual acceptance; no predetermined direction, forecast acceptance or source verification from remembered tradition.
method.failure_policy: Explicit criterion violation fail; unverifiable traditional support or weighting uncertain; mechanical validation and disclaimers do not override local failures.
